text: I saw reviews saying the doctor was gentle and gave good advice, so I decided to try their services. I arrived early, planning to wait, but when I went into the clinic, there was no one at the counter, and I was worried they'd think I was a thief 😩, so I called ahead. A female employee came out and asked if I hadn't made an appointment. I said I did, but I arrived early. She said, "Then please wait," and I said okay. Then she asked if I had called earlier, and I said yes. She said, "Well, you'll have to wait then, because we're working in the back." I just said okay. Honestly, I knew I arrived early, but the employee had no customer service attitude at all. Her tone was rude, and her facial expression was completely unwelcoming. She might have been tired from work or whatever, but I'm a customer, and I wasn't prepared for her rudeness. So, I decided not to use their services and just walked out. That way, they'll have one less customer and won't have to work as hard.
